heroHeadline: Storm-Sequence Death Toll Jumps to 39 as 178 Areas Now Under Calamity; Grids Hit Red Alert Again
heroSubtitle: M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet-Pilandok storm sequence have killed 168+ across the cascade; OCD's Sept 2 report put the August-September storm toll at 39 with 9.4 million affected and 178 cities/municipalities under a state of calamity, while 2 of 4 people missing since the Agana Bridge collapse in Tarlac have now been recovered, Tropical Storm Pilandok exited the PAR Sept 3, and the Visayas and Mindanao grids both hit red alert again Sept 4 amid a worsening power-plant outage crisis
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
